analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 14, 2026, reporting a 35% year-on-year growth in quarterly revenue from operations to ₹532 crore and a 36% year-on-year increase in EBITDA to ₹89 crore. Management discussed operational challenges including raw material constraints, geopolitical uncertainties in West Asia, and monsoon variability, which were mitigated by backward integration, diversified sourcing, and disciplined working capital management. The company also introduced new complex fertilizer variants and executed a 5-for-1 stock split to enhance retail investor liquidity. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported robust operational and financial performance for Q1 FY27, with quarterly revenue growing 34.58% YoY to Rs 532.3 crore and PAT rising 53.88% YoY to Rs 47.06 crore, supported by capacity utilization and cost control. Management highlighted favorable demand drivers including improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve an additional 30%-35% turnover over last year.
guidance.quote: We hope that we will be able to achieve our target for this year, which comes to around 25% of last year's revenue. So, your figure of 30%–35%, we can say that we will be able to achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth of around 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

guidance.claim: Trading revenue is expected to be around Rs. 1,000 crore based on an anticipated import of 150,000 metric tons of material in FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Rainfall improved materially in early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress and accelerated fertilizer offtake.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth supported by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy framework create a favourable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: A structural shift toward balanced nutrient application is further strengthening long-term sector prospects.
demand_outlook.quote: A structural shift toward balanced nutrient application is further strengthening long-term sector prospects.

demand_outlook.claim: The Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry with comfortable domestic stock levels and favorable monsoon forecasts.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops approached maturity.
demand_outlook.quote: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity consistent with typical fertilizer application cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure as food demand is non-negotiable.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity stood at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with a sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin is approximately 7%-8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25%-30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to Rs 47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: From mid-February onwards, the global market witnessed firming input cost trends driven by supply-side constraints, gas-linked production tightness, and higher freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Ammonia and sulphur prices moved up sequentially during the closing quarter.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter. Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March.

margins_costs.claim: Margins are expected to face pressure in the first quarter of FY27 due to rising input costs.
margins_costs.quote: While there may be some margin pressure in the first quarter, we expect margins to stabilize in the later part of the year as cost increases are passed on.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved 43% capacity utilization of the NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT with an additional 165,000 MT taking total capacity to 495,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production for Q4 FY26 reached 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi demand.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total annual production for FY26 reached 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: NPK/DAP and SSP plants operated above rated capacity during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Record high utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants operating above rated capacity, highlighting strong market acceptance and efficient asset utilization

capital_allocation.claim: The company executed a 5-for-1 stock split subdividing equity shares from ₹10 to ₹2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and shipping lane disruptions introduced uncertainty across global fertilizer supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prices of key inputs like ammonia and sulfur increased while phosphatic acid and rock phosphate prices remained elevated.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, prices of key inputs such as ammonia and sulfur increased, while phosphatic acid and rock phosphate prices also remained elevated, placing additional cost pressure on the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices rose from around ₹65,000-₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: A timing mismatch occurred where domestic demand slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, creating higher cost pressure.
risks_headwinds.quote: This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry relies on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia capacity agreement with SECI will start in FY29 after 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains focused on disciplined execution and long-term value creation through the remainder of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

management_commitments.claim: The company entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement under India's National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.
management_commitments.quote: Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the benefits of the recent capacity expansion to reflect in performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management is committed to maintaining best asset utilization during the current year.
management_commitments.quote: For the current year as well, we are committed to maintaining similar performance.
